Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 111: July 2010
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #111 shipped to subscribers in June 2010 (bearing the cover date of July 2010 for Issue 111). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #111 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Mafia II (open-world action-adventure)
Kane & Lynch 2: Dog Days (third-person shooter)
Madden NFL 11 (sports simulation)
Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light (Xbox Live Arcade isometric action-adventure)
Castlevania: Harmony of Despair (Xbox Live Arcade multiplayer action-platformer)
Monday Night Combat (Xbox Live Arcade third-person shooter MOBA)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring E3 2010 reveals including Kinect, Halo: Reach, Gears of War 3, and Call of Duty: Black Ops, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
